title: Internal Story
tagline: Internal story is decentralized inventory management system. The goal is to provide people to manage a simple retail store using our inventory management system and accept crpto payments
description:
We plan on using this boilerplate I built:
https://github.com/Rashmi-278/Web3-Nextjs-ChakraUI

Tech Stack:
* Textile.io
* Ipfs , textile with ipfs for our storage requirements
* Polygon  we are using this as our testnet
* Pillar for multichain wallet   we used etherspot sdk for our wallet requirements and subscribe to events
how_its_made:
'- [ ] CRUD operaions implementing inventory management schema using textile buckets



- [ ] Simple UI frontend enabling user ( connected via wallet ) to perform CRUD operations 



- [ ] Add payment mechanism Display payment address where the the buyer can copy the address and make the payment
